verses.restored: Now these are the children of the province who went up from the exile, those whom Nebuchadnezzar (Hebrew נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֥ר) king of Babylon had carried away to Babylon and who returned to Jerusalem and Judah, each to his city.

familiar.text: Now these are the children of the province that went up out of the captivity, of those which had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away unto Babylon, and came again unto Jerusalem and Judah, every one unto his city;

verses.restored: The children of Neziah and Hatipha.

familiar.text: The children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.

modern.text: the descendants of Neziah, and the descendants of Hatipha.

original.text: בְּנֵ֥י נְצִ֖יחַ בְּנֵ֥י חֲטִיפָֽא

familiar.text: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Peruda,

modern.text: The descendants of the servants of Solomon: the descendants of Sotai, the descendants of Sophereth, the descendants of Peruda,

verses.restored: The children of Jaalah, Darkon, and Giddel.

familiar.text: The children of Jaalah, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

modern.text: the descendants of Jaala, the descendants of Darkon, the descendants of Giddel,

original.text: בְּנֵי יַעְלָ֥ה בְנֵי דַרְק֖וֹן בְּנֵ֥י גִדֵּֽל

verses.restored: The children of Shephatiah, Hattil, Pochereth of Zebaim, and Ami.

familiar.text: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth of Zebaim, the children of Ami.

modern.text: the descendants of Shephatiah, the descendants of Hattil, the descendants of Pochereth-hazzebaim, and the descendants of Ami.

original.text: בְּנֵ֧י שְׁפַטְיָ֣ה בְנֵֽי חַטִּ֗יל בְּנֵ֛י פֹּכֶ֥רֶת הַצְּבָיִ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י אָמִֽי

verses.restored: All the Nethinim and the children of Solomon’s servants: three hundred ninety and two.

familiar.text: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon’s servants, were three hundred ninety and two.

modern.text: The temple servants and descendants of the servants of Solomon numbered 392 in all.

original.text: כָּ֨ל הַנְּתִינִ֔ים וּבְנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם

verses.restored: And these who went up from Tel‑melah, Tel‑harsa, Cherub, Addan, and Immer could not declare their father’s houses and their seed; whether they were of Israel was uncertain.

familiar.text: And these were they which went up from Telmelah, Telharsa, Cherub, Addan, and Immer: but they could not shew their father’s house, and their seed, whether they were of Israel:

modern.text: The following came up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsha, Cherub, Addan, and Immer, but could not prove that their families were descended from Israel:

original.text: וְאֵ֗לֶּה הָֽעֹלִים֙ מִתֵּ֥ל מֶ֨לַח֙ תֵּ֣ל חַרְשָׁ֔א כְּר֥וּב אַדָּ֖ן אִמֵּ֑ר וְלֹ֣א יָֽכְל֗וּ לְהַגִּ֤יד בֵּית אֲבוֹתָם֙ וְזַרְעָ֔ם אִ֥ם מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵֽם

verses.restored: The children of Delaiah, Tobiah, and Nekoda: six hundred fifty and two.

familiar.text: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred fifty and two.

modern.text: the descendants of Delaiah, the descendants of Tobiah, and the descendants of Nekoda, 652 in all.

original.text: בְּנֵי דְלָיָ֥ה בְנֵי טוֹבִיָּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י נְקוֹדָ֑א שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם

verses.restored: And of the priests: the children of Habaiah, Koz, and Barzillai — who took wives from the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite and were called by their names.

familiar.text: And of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai; which took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name:

modern.text: And from among the priests: the descendants of Hobaiah, the descendants of Hakkoz, and the descendants of Barzillai (who had married a daughter of Barzillai the Gileadite and was called by their name).

original.text: וּמִבְּנֵי֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים בְּנֵ֥י חֳבַיָּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י הַקּ֑וֹץ בְּנֵ֣י בַרְזִלַּ֗י אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָ֠קַח מִבְּנ֞וֹת בַּרְזִלַּ֤י הַגִּלְעָדִי֙ אִשָּׁ֔ה וַיִּקָּרֵ֖א עַל שְׁמָֽם

verses.restored: These sought their registration among those reckoned by genealogy, but they were not found; therefore they were excluded from the priesthood.

familiar.text: These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but they were not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.

notes.title: short
notes.body: Exclusion due to absence from genealogical rolls; 'polluted' in tradition implies ritual impurity, not moral judgement alone.

modern.text: These men searched for their family records, but they could not find them and so were excluded from the priesthood as unclean.

original.text: אֵ֗לֶּה בִּקְשׁ֧וּ כְתָבָ֛ם הַמִּתְיַחְשִׂ֖ים וְלֹ֣א נִמְצָ֑אוּ וַֽיְגֹאֲל֖וּ מִן הַכְּהֻנָּֽה

verses.restored: And the Tirshatha said to them that they should not eat of the most holy things until a priest should stand up with Urim and Thummim.

familiar.text: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and with Thummim.

notes.title: short
notes.body: Tirshatha = Persian governor; Urim and Thummim denote accepted cultic decision devices.

modern.text: The governor ordered them not to eat the most holy things until there was a priest to consult the Urim and Thummim.

original.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר הַתִּרְשָׁ֨תָא֙ לָהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא יֹאכְל֖וּ מִקֹּ֣דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֑ים עַ֛ד עֲמֹ֥ד כֹּהֵ֖ן לְאוּרִ֥ים וּלְתֻמִּֽים

verses.restored: The whole assembly together numbered forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore.

familiar.text: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,

modern.text: The whole assembly numbered 42,360,

original.text: כָּל הַקָּהָ֖ל כְּאֶחָ֑ד אַרְבַּ֣ע רִבּ֔וֹא אַלְפַּ֖יִם שְׁלֹשׁ מֵא֥וֹת שִׁשִּֽׁים

verses.restored: Besides their servants and their maids — seven thousand three hundred and thirty and seven; and among them were two hundred singing men and singing women.

familiar.text: Beside their servants and their maids, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and there were among them two hundred singing men and singing women.

modern.text: in addition to their 7,337 menservants and maidservants, as well as their 200 male and female singers.

original.text: מִ֠לְּבַד עַבְדֵיהֶ֤ם וְאַמְהֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ אֵ֔לֶּה שִׁבְעַ֣ת אֲלָפִ֔ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וְשִׁבְעָ֑ה וְלָהֶ֛ם מְשֹׁרְרִ֥ים וּֽמְשֹׁרְר֖וֹת מָאתָֽיִם

verses.restored: Their horses: seven hundred thirty and six; their mules: two hundred forty and five.

familiar.text: Their horses were seven hundred thirty and six; their mules, two hundred forty and five;

modern.text: They had 736 horses, 245 mules,

original.text: סוּסֵיהֶ֕ם שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֑ה פִּרְדֵיהֶ֕ם מָאתַ֖יִם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה

verses.restored: Their camels: four hundred thirty and five; their asses: six thousand seven hundred and twenty.

familiar.text: Their camels, four hundred thirty and five; their asses, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.

modern.text: 435 camels, and 6,720 donkeys. Offerings by the Exiles (Exodus 38:21–31; Nehemiah 7:70–73)

original.text: גְּמַ֨לֵּיהֶ֔ם אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֑ה חֲמֹרִ֕ים שֵׁ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְעֶשְׂרִֽים

verses.restored: And some of the chiefs of the fathers, when they came to the house of YHWH which is in Jerusalem, freely offered to the house of God to set it up in its place;

familiar.text: And some of the chief of the fathers, when they came to the house of the LORD which is at Jerusalem, offered freely for the house of God to set it up in his place:

modern.text: When they arrived at the house of the LORD in Jerusalem, some of the heads of the families gave freewill offerings to rebuild the house of God on its original site.

original.text: וּמֵרָאשֵׁי֙ הָֽאָב֔וֹת בְּבוֹאָ֕ם לְבֵ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם הִֽתְנַדְּבוּ֙ לְבֵ֣ית הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים לְהַעֲמִיד֖וֹ עַל מְכוֹנֽוֹ

verses.restored: They gave according to their ability to the treasury for the work: gold measured in daric-like weights, sixty‑one thousand; and silver, five thousand minas; and one hundred priestly garments.

familiar.text: They gave after their ability unto the treasure of the work threescore and one thousand drams of gold, and five thousand pound of silver, and one hundred priests’ garments.

modern.text: According to their ability, they gave to the treasury for this work 61,000 darics of gold, 5,000 minas of silver, and 100 priestly garments.

original.text: כְּכֹחָ֗ם נָתְנוּ֮ לְאוֹצַ֣ר הַמְּלָאכָה֒ זָהָ֗ב דַּרְכְּמוֹנִים֙ שֵׁשׁ רִבֹּ֣אות וָאֶ֔לֶף וְכֶ֕סֶף מָנִ֖ים חֲמֵ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֑ים וְכָתְנֹ֥ת כֹּהֲנִ֖ים מֵאָֽה

verses.restored: So the priests, and the Levites, and some of the people, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinim lived in their cities; and all Israel dwelt in their cities.

familiar.text: So the priests, and the Levites, and some of the people, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, dwelt in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.

modern.text: So the priests, the Levites, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the temple servants, along with some of the people, settled in their own towns; and the rest of the Israelites settled in their towns.

original.text: וַיֵּשְׁב֣וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְ֠הַלְוִיִּם וּֽמִן הָעָ֞ם וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִ֧ים וְהַשּׁוֹעֲרִ֛ים וְהַנְּתִינִ֖ים בְּעָרֵיהֶ֑ם וְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּעָרֵיהֶֽם

translation_notes: Divine name in source rendered as YHWH (Hebrew יהוה) where present (v.68).
Genealogical names follow Hebrew forms; numerals preserved from source but many ancient totals show textual variance — see audit flags.
Tirshatha (v.63) is a Persian-era official title; 'Nethinim' retained as a group-name reflecting cultic service.
safety_note: This chapter lists servile groups, ritual exclusion, and population counts; treat identity data carefully and avoid modern targeting.
